text: Decision: eyes4s will not reverse-engineer or bundle the proprietary EyeLink EDF binary format in the portable core. The supported boundary is an explicitly identified vendor EDF2ASC conversion followed by the eyes4s ASC parser. Reliability claims are configuration-bounded and require independent EDF Access API plus available vendor ASC-reference manifests, exact line accounting, named tolerances, cross-platform parity, mutation proof, performance evidence, and a release-bound validation artifact. EyeLink online events remain native vendor evidence, not eyes4s DetectionResult.
